summary: Read a positive integer n. Express n as a sum of square numbers and use as few terms as possible, then write that smallest term count. A square number is an integer multiplied by itself. The values 1, 4, 9, and 16 belong to this class, while 3 and 11 do not. Every term must be a square number, and the same square number may be used more than once. n runs from 1 to 104.
notes: Compare after trimming trailing newlines. The input is tokens in the same order as the method parameters.
